cards.front: ¿Cómo estás? (pregunta habitual)
cards.back: How are you?

cards.front: ¿Cómo te va? (saludo habitual)
cards.back: How's it going?

cards.front: ¿Cómo estás? (con «doing»)
cards.back: How are you doing?

cards.front: ¿Cómo te encuentras? (presente simple)
cards.back: How do you feel?

cards.front: ¿Cómo te encuentras? (presente continuo)
cards.back: How are you feeling?

cards.front: ¿Cómo se encuentra tu suegra?
cards.back: How's your mother-in-law feeling?

cards.front: ¡Me siento genial esta mañana!
cards.back: I feel great this morning!

cards.front: Roger se siente un poco indispuesto en este momento. Es por eso que no está en su sitio.
cards.back: Roger's feeling a bit ill at the moment. That's why he's not at his desk.

cards.front: Tengo ganas de devolver. ¿Me puedes llevar al baño, por favor?
cards.back: I feel sick. Can you take me to the bathroom, please?

cards.front: No tengo mucha hambre hoy.
cards.back: I don't feel very hungry today.

cards.front: Tengo mucha sed. ¿Tienes sed también?
cards.back: I feel really thirsty. Do you feel thirsty too?

cards.front: Tengo un poco de frío. Me voy a poner el jersey.
cards.back: I feel a bit cold. I'm going to put my jumper on.

cards.front: Estoy un poco triste hoy. ¡Es por el tiempo!
cards.back: I feel a bit sad today. It's the weather!

cards.front: Estoy un poco nerviosa por lo de ir al médico.
cards.back: I feel a bit nervous about going to the doctor's.

cards.front: Estoy un poco cansado hoy. Siempre me siento cansado los viernes.
cards.back: I'm feeling a bit tired today. I always feel tired on Fridays.

cards.front: Estoy seguro de que te sentirás mejor mañana.
cards.back: I'm sure you'll feel better tomorrow.

cards.front: Toma esta medicina y te sentirás mejor.
cards.back: Take this medicine and you'll feel better.

cards.front: Toma uno de éstos y te sentirás mejor.
cards.back: Take one of these and you'll feel better.

cards.front: Te sentirás mucho mejor cuando te tomes uno de éstos.
cards.back: You'll feel much better when you take one of these.

cards.front: Te sentirás mejor cuando llegues a casa.
cards.back: You'll feel better when you get home.

cards.front: Te sentirás mejor cuando estés en el avión.
cards.back: You'll feel better when you're on the plane.

cards.front: Si él se siente mejor, saldrá esta noche.
cards.back: If he feels better, he'll go out tonight.

cards.front: Si ella se siente mejor, irá al trabajo mañana.
cards.back: If she feels better, she'll go to work tomorrow.

cards.front: Si se sienten mejor, te llamarán.
cards.back: If they feel better, they'll call you.

cards.front: Me sentiré mejor si me tomo uno de éstos.
cards.back: I'll feel better if I take one of these.

cards.front: Te sentirás mejor si no comes nada esta noche.
cards.back: You'll feel better if you don't eat anything tonight.

cards.front: Te llamaré si me siento mejor mañana.
cards.back: I'll call you if I feel better tomorrow.

cards.front: Te sentirás peor si no te tomas la medicina.
cards.back: You'll feel worse if you don't take your medicine.

cards.front: Si ella hace eso, se sentirá peor.
cards.back: If she does that, she'll feel worse.

cards.front: Estoy seguro de que me sentiré peor cuando llegue al hospital.
cards.back: I'm sure I'll feel worse when I get to the hospital.

cards.front: No te sentirás nada mejor si no te vas a la cama.
cards.back: You won't feel any better if you don't go to bed.

cards.front: No se sentirán nada mejor si no hacen algo de ejercicio.
cards.back: They won't feel any better if they don't do some exercise.

cards.front: Ella no se sentirá nada mejor si no le llama.
cards.back: She won't feel any better if she doesn't call him.

cards.front: No te sentirás mejor hasta que hables de ello con tu jefe.
cards.back: You won't feel any better until you speak to your boss about it.

cards.front: No te sentirás mejor hasta que te tomes la medicina.
cards.back: You won't feel any better until you take your medicine.

cards.front: No te sentirás mejor hasta que pares.
cards.back: You won't feel any better until you stop.

cards.front: Ella no se sentirá mejor hasta que duerma algo.
cards.back: She won't feel any better until she gets some sleep.

cards.front: Él tampoco se sentirá mejor hasta que se eche un poco.
cards.back: He won't feel any better either until he gets some sleep.

cards.front: No te sentirás nada mejor si no duermes un poco.
cards.back: You won't feel any better if you don't get any sleep.

cards.front: No te sentirás mejor a no ser que duermas un poco.
cards.back: You won't feel any better unless you get some sleep.

cards.front: No dormirás nada a no ser que vayas a la cama. Y si no duermes nada, ¡no te sentirás mejor!
cards.back: You won't get any sleep unless you go to bed. And if you don't get any sleep, you won't feel any better!

cards.front: No te sentirás mejor a no ser que descanses un poco.
cards.back: You won't feel any better unless you get some rest.

cards.front: No te sentirás peor a no ser que no duermas.
cards.back: You won't feel any worse unless you don't get any sleep.

cards.front: Ella no se sentirá peor a no ser que no tome su medicina.
cards.back: She won't feel any worse unless she doesn't take her medicine.

cards.front: No llamaré al médico a no ser que ella se encuentre peor.
cards.back: I won't call the doctor unless she feels any worse.

cards.front: ¿Te apetece un café?
cards.back: Do you feel like a coffee?

cards.front: Sí, me apetece un café con leche. ¿Y a ti?
cards.back: Yes, I feel like a white coffee. How about you?

cards.front: No me apetece un café con leche, me apetece un café solo.
cards.back: I don't feel like a white coffee, I feel like a black coffee.

cards.front: Me apetece un paseo. ¿Te apetece un paseo?
cards.back: I feel like a walk. Do you feel like a walk?

cards.front: No me apetece un paseo largo.
cards.back: I don't feel like a long walk.

cards.front: Bueno, ¿entonces te apetece un paseo corto?
cards.back: Well, do you feel like a short walk then?

cards.front: Me apetece una siesta rapidita. ¿Y a ti?
cards.back: I feel like a quick nap. How about you?

cards.front: Siempre me apetece una siesta después de una comida fuerte.
cards.back: I always feel like a kip after a big lunch.

cards.front: Pareces cansado. ¿Te apetece una siesta?
cards.back: You look tired. Do you feel like forty winks?

cards.front: Me apetece tomar algo. ¿Y a ti?
cards.back: I feel like a drink. How about you?

cards.front: Me apetece beber algo frío.
cards.back: I feel like a cold drink.

cards.front: Ahora mismo me apetece beber algo caliente. ¡Estoy helado!
cards.back: Right now, I feel like a hot drink. I'm freezing!

cards.front: Me apetece algo diferente. ¿Y a ti?
cards.back: I feel like something different. How about you?

cards.front: Me apetece algo dulce. ¿Y a ti?
cards.back: I feel like something sweet. How about you?

cards.front: Me apetece algo salado. ¿Y a ti?
cards.back: I feel like something savoury. How about you?

cards.front: Me apetece comprar el periódico. ¿Qué es lo que te apetece hacer a ti?
cards.back: I feel like buying the newspaper. What do you feel like doing?

cards.front: No me apetece ir a trabajar hoy.
cards.back: I don't feel like going to work today.

cards.front: ¿Te apetece ir a Bruselas durante el fin de semana?
cards.back: Do you feel like going to Brussels for the weekend?

cards.front: Me apetece dar un paseo corto. ¿Quieres venir?
cards.back: I feel like going for a short walk. Do you want to come?

cards.front: No me apetece ir a caminar hoy. Estoy cansada.
cards.back: I don't feel like going for a walk today. I'm tired.

cards.front: Voy a ir a caminar. ¿Te apetece venir?
cards.back: I'm going to go for a walk. Do you feel like coming?

cards.front: Me apetece echarme una siesta. ¿Qué es lo que te apetece hacer a ti?
cards.back: I feel like having forty winks. What do you feel like doing?

cards.front: ¿Te apetece echar una siesta?
cards.back: Do you feel like having a nap?

cards.front: Tengo muchas ganas de echar una siesta.
cards.back: I really feel like having a kip.

cards.front: Me apetece tomar algo fresquito.
cards.back: I feel like having a nice cold drink.

cards.front: Pues a mí me apetece tomar algo calentito.
cards.back: Well, I feel like having a nice hot drink.

cards.front: A mi marido siempre le apetece tomar algo cuando vuelve a casa del trabajo.
cards.back: My husband always feels like having a drink when he gets home from work.

cards.front: Me apetece hacer algo diferente para variar. ¿Qué es lo que te apetece hacer a ti?
cards.back: I feel like doing something different for a change. What do you feel like doing?

cards.front: ¿Te apetece hacer algo interesante para variar?
cards.back: Do you feel like doing something interesting for a change?

cards.front: Nos apetece hacer algo nuevo para variar.
cards.back: We feel like doing something new for a change.

cards.front: Voy a dar un paseo. ¿Le apetece a alguien venir?
cards.back: I'm going to go for a walk. Does anyone feel like coming?

cards.front: Voy a fregar. ¿Le apetece a alguien echarme una mano?
cards.back: I'm going to do the dishes. Does anyone feel like giving me a hand?

cards.front: Voy a hacer café. ¿Le apetece a alguien una taza?
cards.back: I'm going to make some coffee. Does anyone feel like a cup?

cards.front: Voy a llamar a Marta. ¿A alguien le apetece hablar con ella después de mí?
cards.back: I'm going to phone Marta. Does anybody feel like speaking to her after me?

cards.front: Voy a ir al supermercado. ¿Le apetece a alguien venir conmigo?
cards.back: I'm going to go to the supermarket. Does anybody feel like coming with me?

cards.front: Voy a lavar el coche. ¿Le apetece a alguien echarme una mano?
cards.back: I'm going to wash the car. Does anybody feel like giving me a hand?

cards.front: A nadie le apetece hacer nada con este tiempo.
cards.back: No one feels like doing anything in this weather.

cards.front: A nadie le apetece dar un paseo con esta lluvia.
cards.back: No one feels like going for a walk in this rain.

cards.front: A nadie le apetece jugar al fútbol con esta nieve.
cards.back: No one feels like playing football in this snow.

cards.front: A nadie le apetece un helado en diciembre.
cards.back: Nobody feels like an ice cream in December.

cards.front: A nadie le apetece ir a la playa en enero.
cards.back: Nobody feels like going to the beach in January.

cards.front: A nadie le apetece ir de compras cuando tiene gripe.
cards.back: Nobody feels like going shopping when they have flu.

cards.front: A nadie le apetece hablar con nadie cuando tiene gripe.
cards.back: Nobody feels like speaking to anybody when they have flu.

cards.front: A nadie le apetece tomar una cerveza con nadie cuando tiene gripe.
cards.back: Nobody feels like having a beer with anybody when they have flu.

cards.front: A nadie le apetece salir con nadie cuando tiene gripe.
cards.back: Nobody feels like going out with anybody when they have flu.
